== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Jawa Ion Gun (Japanese)|Jawa Ion Gun]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67707 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(18, 6, 471, 631)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e6a0dc83c8cb8ab2ee0cc1a3298192d54ef1fe647a6e929bcd9b183356ff6956</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
